correctness.rationale: Under invariant affine-hyperplane measure conditioned on meeting the cube, the correct law is Gaussian width-weighted: E_aff F=(2nmu)^-1 E_G ∫[-L,L]F(G,t)dt, L=Σ|G_i|, mu=sqrt(2/pi). Every section vertex corresponds a.s. to one edge interval; integrating single intervals gives known EV_n=2^(n-1). Summing pairwise overlap lengths yields the exact second moment. Same-direction pairs have probability 1/n and are O(1/n) in overlap. For distinct directions the center difference is Z+σA+τB, with Z|H~N(0,4H) and H~Bin(n-2,1/2). The normalized Gaussian density at bounded offsets tends 1/sqrt(4πn); ∫intersection_length(x)dx=4AB. Chernoff on H<n/4 plus integrable Gaussian density envelope proves sqrt(n)Eoverlap→2mu²/sqrt(pi). Combining prefactors gives Var V_n/(4^n sqrt(n))→1/(2sqrt2 pi) after subtracting the mean square. For typical-to-mean separation, the offset |U|L is order n away from |U|<delta and all random signed edge centers have subgaussian O(sqrt n) tails, yielding V_n/2^(n-1)→0 in probability. Independently derived the coefficient exactly as sqrt(2)/(4pi); no claim that finite simulations prove the asymptotic.
